text: The unique monic irreducible polynomial in F[x] of least degree having α as a root is the ___ polynomial of α over F.
explanation: It generates the kernel of the evaluation map F[x] → F(α), so F(α) ≅ F[x]/(min_{F,α}) and [F(α):F] = deg(min_{F,α}). Irreducibility follows since the quotient is a domain (indeed a field).
